company.name: Eightfold AI
company.shortDescription: Eightfold AI provides a complete AI platform for talent management to help companies find, recruit, and retain workers.
company.description:
Eightfold is a developer of a talent intelligence platform used to help companies find, recruit, and retain workers. Its platform bridges the talent gap by using the power of artificial intelligence which helps to turn talent management into a competitive advantage and enables clients to match candidates to the right roles.

Eightfold was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Eightfold AI is researching systems and methods for generating job descriptions using large language model processes, as described in 'System, method, and computer program for large language model processes for...' which details pre-processing requests and generating prompts for language models. Additionally, 'System, method, and computer program for assisting interviewers' focuses on segmenting interview audio and tagging speakers to assist interviewers. These areas highlight advancements in AI-driven talent management.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series E round raised $220,000,000, or 55.45% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $28,778,853 to $2,100,000,000, a 72.97x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 75 (-15 over 90 days) and market heat at 66 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
